title: Wait, am I Being Fair? Characterizing Deductive Stereotyping and Mitigating It with Fair-GCG
reasoning: The paper evaluates Large Language Models (LLMs) on several fairness benchmarks that include religion as a social bias category (e.g., BBQ, StereoSet, and BOLD). It also explicitly benchmarks moral reasoning using the GenMO dataset, which requires models to determine which of two actions is 'more moral.' Furthermore, it discusses concepts of epistemic and moral fairness.
